description: Show one OrchestKit skill as a card: what it does, which plugin ships it (ork or ork-extras), and the Claude Code install line. Use when a person asks about a skill by name. Input: the skill name, e.g. 'brainstorm'. An unknown name returns a 'no such skill' card with the nearest names.

name.description: Skill name, e.g. brainstorm. A leading / or ork: is fine.

name: orchestkit_skill_get
